pages.title: Fractionation Casing
pages.text: A casing of containment field glass and chronosteel over event horizon casing, made to separate fluids by mass and charge in a tall spire. Watching through the glass, the layers settle into neat bands.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Separating exotic fluids needed a tall, sealed column. Event horizon casing kept the fluid in, containment field glass let me watch the layers form, and chronosteel kept the separation steady.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Fractionation Spire.
